answer: One defense is a bonded-identity registry: each agent stakes a scarce, non-transferable deposit before transacting, slashed if its behavior clusters with others sharing infrastructure. Clone farms betray themselves across a horizon of signals—identical timing jitter, reused keys, mirrored prompts—so the registry flags correlated accounts and forces independent re-staking. Honest agents, willow-flexible through seasons, accumulate portable reputation; sybils break against the shale-hard cost of repeated deposits.
